verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs describe managing SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA and PCI-DSS in one place with 'pre-mapped controls', which implies some shared control mapping. Nothing explicitly says work for one framework automatically counts toward another, or that the overlap is shown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-framework control/evidence mapping, automatic crediting of SOC 2 work toward ISO 27001/HIPAA, an overlap visualization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
